question: Who is the author of the book ’Above Average’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amitabha Bagchi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amitabha Bagchi** is an acclaimed Indian author known for his unique storytelling and deep insights into urban and social life.
 
• His book **‘Above Average’** is a semi-autobiographical novel that explores the life of a middle-class student navigating the pressures of academics, friendships, and society.
 
• The novel is set in **Delhi**, particularly around the prestigious Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), capturing the struggles and aspirations of students in a competitive educational environment.
 
• Amitabha Bagchi uses a humorous yet poignant narrative style to depict the protagonist's journey through adolescence and adulthood.
 
• ‘Above Average’ received widespread acclaim for its relatable characters, realistic depiction of middle-class Indian life, and the challenges faced by youth in academic and societal settings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amitabha Bagchi:**

 
 
• He was born in **Delhi** and has a background in computer science.
 
• Bagchi worked as a professor at the **Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Delhi,** before transitioning to full-time writing.
 
• His works often delve into themes of urban life, middle-class struggles, and the interplay of tradition and modernity in Indian society.
 
• Apart from ‘Above Average,’ Bagchi has written other notable books such as **‘The Householder’** and **‘Half the Night is Gone’**, the latter winning the **2018 DSC Prize for South Asian Literature**.
 
 
 
• **Other Options:**
 
 
• **Amit Varma:** Known for his book **‘My Friend Sancho,’** which is a humorous take on journalism and relationships in urban India.
 
• **Anita Nair:** She is celebrated for her literary works such as **‘Ladies Coupé’** and **‘The Better Man,’** focusing on gender roles and societal norms in India.
 
• **Amish Tripathi:** Famous for his mythological fiction series, including **‘The Shiva Trilogy’** and **‘Ram Chandra Series,’** which reimagines Indian mythology in a modern context.
